subject: Access custody & fallback plan for Catalyst Health SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 15:13:00 -0800
Subject: Access custody evidence & initial intake for SOC2 (Catalyst)

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Catalyst is kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and Redwoods' SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts are on scope. Security has asked for a focused bundle we can consume that demonstrates custody and lifecycle for user and service accounts. High level ask (we can be flexible):

- SCIM delta snapshot (last 90 days) — sample CSV showing add/modify/delete events
- SAML assertion samples for a handful of successful logins (with guidance on redaction)
- RBAC ownership matrix and role-to-permission mapping (format doesn't need to be fancy)
- Service account inventory + short audit trail (who created, last used timestamp)
- Any short description of our JIT/delegation policies affecting admin roles

Target timeline: auditors asked for evidence by 2027-01-15.

Preferred transfer: presigned S3 PUT links to a secure bucket (we can receive up to 2GB total). If Redwood has a secure upload portal or SFTP, we can use that instead — let us know what you prefer.

A couple of clarifying Qs for you:
1) For SAML assertions, do you require full NameID/email fields removed or is token-level masking acceptable?
2) For SCIM deltas, a single CSV with an action column (create/update/delete) is ideal — can you deliver a sample first?

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Security Engineer, Catalyst Health
priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com

[Attachment: SOC2_Audit_Timeline_Q1-2027.pdf (referenced)]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 18:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access custody evidence & initial intake for SOC2 (Catalyst)

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear list. We can put together the bundle you listed and propose a minimal handoff process so you can ingest without delays. Outline / plan: 

- Deliverables (initial bundle):
  * scim-delta-sample.csv (90-day delta, limited PII)
  * saml-assertions-sample.txt (3 successful login samples; we will redact sensitive PII following the rules below)
  * rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx (role -> permissions -> owner contact)
  * service-account-inventory.csv (service account name, created_by, last_used_iso)
  * handoff_playbook_v1.pdf (short playbook describing extraction queries and redaction steps)

- Transfer options (we support all three):
  1) Presigned S3 PUT links (preferred for larger bundles)
  2) Encrypted SFTP drop (we will provide account + key)
  3) Secure box link (for smaller PDF/Excel files)

- Redaction guidance (proposed):
  * SCIM CSV: keep username (hashed) optional; remove cleartext password, oauth tokens, or full SSN-like identifiers. Email column may be kept if you need it; we can provide both email and hashed_email columns on request.
  * SAML assertions: we will blank NameID and subject identifiers on samples, keep timestamps/issuer/AssertionID intact. If you require subject-level identifiers for traceability, we can provide a separate mapping under NDA.
  * RBAC matrix: full owner emails are ok to supply; if you'd prefer role owners anonymized, say so.

Stephanie — can you own the RBAC matrix extraction and the schema for scim-delta-sample.csv? Marissa — can you coordinate the delivery timeline and presigned link generation?

We will try to deliver an initial sample set by 2027-01-06 and the full bundle by 2027-01-12 if that meets your audit deadline. If you need anything faster, we can prioritize specific items.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: handoff_playbook_v1.pdf]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 19:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access custody evidence & initial intake for SOC2 (Catalyst)

Thanks — quick technical notes from the IAM side: 

- SCIM delta CSV schema (what I'll produce):
  timestamp_iso, action(create|update|delete), scim_id, username_hash, email_masked, source_connector, changed_by, change_reason

- For SAML samples, our standard redaction will: replace user principal names with <redacted_user_N>, keep AssertionID, IssueInstant, Audience, and InResponseTo fields. Example: 
  <saml:NameID> <redacted_user_1> </saml:NameID>

- Service account traces: we can include the last_used_iso and a short event history for each service account (max 10 events).

- One ask: if you accept presigned links, please confirm the target bucket and preferred object prefix (we'll generate short-lived PUTs).

> 
> Catalyst is kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and Redwoods' SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts are on scope. Security has asked for a focused bundle we can consume that demonstrates custody and lifecycle for user and service accounts.
> 
> Target timeline: auditors asked for evidence by 2027-01-15.
> 
> Preferred transfer: presigned S3 PUT links to a secure bucket (we can receive up to 2GB total).
> 
> Thanks,
> Priya
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Access custody evidence & initial intake for SOC2 (Catalyst)

Irene / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the suggested redaction rules. We confirm: 

- Presigned S3 PUT links are acceptable. Preferred object prefix: audits/catalyst-health/soc2-2027/
- For SAML samples, your proposed redaction approach is fine (we do not need raw emails in samples). If you can include a small mapping under NDA for traceability, that would be ideal but not required for the first pass.
- We accept the SCIM CSV schema you proposed.

ETA: if you can send the initial sample bundle by 2027-01-06 (as proposed), that gives our auditors time to review before the 01-15 deadline.

Two small follow-ups: 
1) Can you include one example of a delegated admin/JIT elevation event (redacted) in the service-account event history?
2) Please confirm whether RBAC owner emails will be provided in the matrix or we should expect role owners as redacted identifiers.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the handoff.

Priya Sharma
Security Engineer, Catalyst Health
priya.sharma@catalysthealth.com
